title: Paper Mario: Boggly Woods
alt: A wood under a gold sky. The trees have black trunks like tall cones and round heads of white leaves. A white path winds away across dark blue ground, between two rows of small black pointed bushes. Far off stands a tree as big as a hill, with a wide brown trunk and a head like heaped tan clouds. A large white paper plane glides through the sky toward it. On its folded side are a red cap with a white round and a red M, brown hair, a face, and blue at the nose. On the path below runs a small round grey creature with a ball on a stalk on its head. Blue ferns with rolled ends stand at the foot of the picture.
summary: A painting of Boggly Woods from Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Boggly Woods, from Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door, by Intelligent Systems. The wood has a gold sky, black trunks and white leaves. The great tree far off is the home of the Punies.

Punio, the small one on the path, came to ask for help, because invaders have taken the tree. Mario goes there by air: in this world people are paper, and he can fold himself into a plane. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
